excluded: ACK advancement or window update piggybacked on payload

CONNECTION-PROFILE.interpretation: Inherited single-connection control paths retain validated control shapes, exact sequence checks and configurable user/MSL deadlines. The data extension supersedes the base zero-payload assumption only in ESTABLISHED, within the explicit DATA-SCOPE boundary; data in other lifecycle states remains excluded.

DATA-SCOPE.interpretation: Inherit finite data send/ACK/window/retransmission scope and connection control; supersede only the discard-future-segments receive policy with explicit finite reassembly.

RX-SCOPE.interpretation: Finite 16-position reassembly queue, shared receive capacity=16 octets, first-accepted-octet-wins overlap policy, non-advancing ACK and unchanged send window in payload events. Only ESTABLISHED, no SACK/delayed ACK/FIN payload/general piggyback.
